method: Initial template — computed from first pass GEFS vs settlement comparison
bias_correction_source: GEFS 31-member ensemble mean vs Kalshi NWS CLI temperature (settlement)
description: Bias = GEFS_mean - actual. Positive = GEFS overpredicts. 20 stations × 4 seasons.
notes: Initial bias values estimated from GEFS 6-member vs settlement comparison. DJF=Dec-Feb, MAM=Mar-May, JJA=Jun-Aug, SON=Sep-Nov. KDEN shows strongest warm bias (GEFS overpredicts by 2-3°F). KLAX shows slight cold bias in summer. These will be refined as more GEFS 31-member data is collected.
